grammar.summary: 本课以「不顾路况疯狂驾驶」为线索，集中运用了 so...that 结果状语从句、让步状语从句与分词短语作状语，并出现 no matter what 引导的条件让步。重点体会叙事中如何用 so...that 表示程度结果、用让步从句表示「无论」、用分词表现驾驶中的连续动作。

points.title: so...that 结果状语从句 (Result Clauses with so...that)
points.explanation: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句，表示「如此……以至于」。本课用 so bad that 描述路况之差以至于想返回，强调程度与结果。

examples.en: The rough across the plain soon became so bad that we tried to get Bruce to drive back to the village we had come from.
examples.cn: 穿越平原的道路高低不平，开车走了不远，路面愈加崎岖。我们想劝说布鲁斯把车开回我们出发的那个村庄去。

examples.en: We felt sure that sooner or later a stone would rip a hole in our petrol tank or damage the engine.
examples.cn: 我们想念迟早会飞起一个石块把油箱砸开一个窟窿，或者把发动机砸坏。

points.title: 让步状语从句 (Concessive Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 even though / no matter what / though 引导让步从句，表示「尽管」「无论」。本课用 even though 表示「尽管路况差」，用 no matter what 表示「无论条件如何」，突出布鲁斯的无畏。

examples.en: Even though the road was littered with boulders and pitted with holes, Bruce was not in the least perturbed.
examples.cn: 尽管路面布满石头，坑坑洼洼，但布鲁斯却一点儿不慌乱。

examples.en: No matter what the conditions were, he believed that a car should be driven as fast as it could possibly go.
examples.cn: 他认为不管路面情况如何，车必须以最高速度前进。

points.title: 分词短语作状语 (Participle Phrases as Adverbials)
points.explanation: 现在分词 (v-ing) 作状语表主动伴随，可表时间、方式、伴随。本课用 Glancing at his map 表「瞥一眼地图时」，用 keeping the front wheels astride 表「同时让前轮跨在裂缝上」，生动刻画驾驶过程。

examples.en: Glancing at his map, he informed us that the next village was a mere twenty miles away.
examples.cn: 他瞥了一眼地图，告诉我们前面再走不到20英里就是一个村庄。

examples.en: Bruce went into a low gear and drove at a terrifying speed, keeping the front wheels astride the crack as he followed its zigzag course.
examples.cn: 布鲁斯挂上慢档，把两只前轮分别搁在裂缝的两边，顺着弯弯曲曲的裂缝，以发疯的速度向前开去。

examples.en: What a relief it was when the boulders suddenly disappeared, giving way to a stretch of plain where the only obstacles were clumps of bushes.
examples.cn: 突然大石块不见了，前面是一片平地，唯一的障碍只有一簇簇灌木丛。这使我们长长地松了口气。

exercises.q: The rough across the plain soon became ______ bad that we tried to get Bruce to drive back to the village we had come from.
______ the road was littered with boulders and pitted with holes, Bruce was not in the least perturbed.
______ what the conditions were, he believed that a car should be driven as fast as it could possibly go.
下列哪个词与课文中 perturb 的含义最接近？
用分词填空：______ (glance) at his map, he informed us that the next village was a mere twenty miles away.（写出 glance 的正确形式）
